FX.title: [USD/JPY] FLAT: Divergence Between China Trade Strength and BoJ Hawkishness
tldr_points: BoJ June hike expectations create a hard ceiling near 160.50
Positive Chinese trade data supports broader risk-on sentiment but limits USD dominance
Price hovering above MA20 suggests short-term resilience despite intervention risks
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY faces resistance as BoJ rate hike expectations clash with positive Chinese trade data and MA20 support.
FX.comment: BoJ hike expectations limit upside while MA20 provides baseline support.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] DOWN: Price Below MA20 Amid Geopolitical Strain
tldr_points: S&P 500 trades below its 20‑day moving average, signaling near‑term bearish momentum.
Escalating Israel‑Iran tensions weigh on risk assets, dragging US equity futures lower.
Emerging‑market outperformance and dividend‑ETF inflows contrast with domestic equity weakness.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 under pressure as price sits below MA20 amid geopolitical strain and mixed fundamental cues.
STOCKS.comment: Price below MA20 with bearish order flow and geopolitical headwinds supports a short‑term decline toward 7300.
